parameters.content:
## Phase 2 multi-opportunity batch
1. Restart: `python -m aliexpress_collector --country FR serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787`.
2. Configure the existing Google Sheets credential in all three Sheets nodes.
3. Processes every pending Phase 1 acceptance; already `PHASE2_RESEARCHED` rows are skipped.
4. For each opportunity, searches up to 25 listings and details the best 10.
5. Only products with a real EUR price and a destination-eligible variant reach Sheets.
6. If a CAPTCHA appears, solve it within three minutes. Incomplete opportunities become `PHASE2_RETRY`.
7. Products are upserted by opportunity plus link; opportunity statuses are matched by product name. No AI tokens are used.
